title: Chapter 466: Battle Of Kings
content:
Chapter 466: Battle Of Kings

Wang Shuo noticed that the army of the Truni Empire was almost full of undead soldiers, and the highest commander was a woman.

Wang Shuo was a little unsure whether she was Queen Anna.

After getting the affirmation from Master Tongchui, Wang Shuo was eager to try.

Wang Shuo knew very well that Queen Anna must not like him.

At that time, he was almost killed by her clone, and the two had a grudge long ago.

Flags were flying and drums were beating.

Emperor Andre of the Parthian Empire walked out of the crowd.

"Kings upstairs, in order to avoid the destruction of lives, why don't our kings fight each other? As long as you defeat us, we will withdraw our troops. How about that?"

Andre had a good idea. A crippled empire would be much less valuable.

If they could defeat all the masters on the opposite side, then they would win the battle directly.

There were 10 strongest kings on their side, and there were several more in secret. When they attacked by surprise, they would definitely be able to catch the other side in one fell swoop.

Ye Hui felt very uncomfortable at this time. He was directly challenged by the opponent. If he did not respond, his morale would be low, and the soldiers on both sides would laugh at him.

If he accepted the challenge, he felt that he had no confidence at all.

"Don't worry, we will fight one-on-one, absolutely fair."

Andre added fuel to the fire and teased.

Ye Hui's face turned pale.

Wang Shuo didn't care. At this moment, he was not the head coach, so it was not convenient for him to interrupt. He just had to follow Ye Hui's arrangements.

Ye Hui turned his head and looked at several kings, and asked the three Shuras in an inquiring tone: "Three, what do you think about this?"

As we all know, the Shura King has the ceiling of all kings in terms of combat power.

These three Shuras, in theory, can fight one against two.

Of course, it is not ruled out that some well-known and ruthless people in their prime also have the strength to compete with Shuras.

These three Shuras are Wang Shuo, the Red Eyed Shura, Zhao Kai, the Masked Shura, and Wu Jin, the Green Sword Shura.

Wang Shuo and these two people have no intersection. In the past few days, he has only met them once, so he is not sure about their strength.

"Ye Huang, I think the other side is too arrogant. We should teach them a lesson. I have no problem dealing with one or two of them. Of course, the final decision still depends on you."

Zhao Kai looked at Wang Shuo and Wu Jin intentionally or unintentionally.

This kind of battle is very serious and will directly affect the final result of this battle.

Ye Hui had to be cautious.

In the melee, if one side kills the other side first, the advantage will be expanded.

It can be said that one careless move will lead to a complete loss.

"I don't care." Wu Jin spread his hands.

Wang Shuo certainly can't admit defeat, and he has 3 helpers.

"I can fight."

Ye Hui thought again and again, gritted his teeth, and said: "Let's do it. If we can't win, we must quickly retreat into the formation."

He said this not entirely for the safety of everyone.

If the city's defense barrier is not broken, the other side will become a living target if they attack rashly, which is extremely beneficial to the defenders.

As long as a king takes action, no matter how many people attack from the opposite side, it will be useless.

Then, he came to the edge of the city wall and said to Andre: "Andre, think about it carefully. If you lose, there will be no regrets."

"Come on! Ye Hui, I have long wanted to fight you."

In this battle, both sides gathered more than 20 of the strongest kings. It can be said that after the battle of Shenwu City, the battle with the largest number of kings on both sides.

Wang Shuo and others flew down from the city wall.
